records.jp: 詩さん
records.en_original: Hi, Uta.
records.en_auxiliary: Hi, Uta.
records.en: Hi, Uta-san.

records.jp: 星崎さん……
records.en_original: Ao...
records.en_auxiliary: Ao...
records.en: Hoshizaki-san...

records.jp: あの後、体調は？
records.en_original: How are you feeling after all that?
records.en_auxiliary: How are you feeling after all that?
records.en: How are you feeling after all that?

records.jp: 私は、はい……。大丈夫です
records.en_original: I'm... Yes, I'm fine.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm... Yes, I'm fine.
records.en: I'm... Yes, I'm fine.

records.jp: そっか。よかった
records.en_original: I'm glad to hear it.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm glad to hear it.
records.en: I'm glad to hear it.

records.jp: ……ごめんなさい。<CR>私のせいで、皆さんに迷惑を……
records.en_original: I'm sorry. I've caused so much trouble for everyone...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sorry. I've caused so much trouble for everyone...
records.en: I'm sorry. I've caused so much trouble for everyone...

records.jp: ううん、それは言いっこ無しにしよ
records.en_original: No, you don't have anything to apologize for.
records.en_auxiliary: No, you don't have anything to apologize for.
records.en: No, you don't have anything to apologize for.

records.jp: あ、ありがとうございます……
records.en_original: Th-thank you...
records.en_auxiliary: Th-thank you...
records.en: Th-thank you...

records.jp: 記憶はどう？
records.en_original: How are your memories?
records.en_auxiliary: How are your memories?
records.en: How are your memories?

records.jp: ……まだ、整理がついていません
records.en_original: I still haven't had a chance to sort them all...
records.en_auxiliary: I still haven't had a chance to sort them all...
records.en: I still haven't had a chance to sort them all...

records.jp: 確かに自分の身に起きたことだって分かるんですが、<CR>でも……実感がどうしても湧かなくて
records.en_original: I know that something happened to me, but for some reason, none of it feels real...
records.en_auxiliary: I know that something happened to me, but for some reason, none of it feels real...
records.en: I know that something happened to me, but for some reason, none of it feels real...

records.jp: 今の自分と、昔の自分か……
records.en_original: Caught between your old self and new self...
records.en_auxiliary: Caught between your old self and new self...
records.en: Caught between your old self and new self...

records.jp: （……今の詩さんは、中途半端な状態）
records.en_original: (The current Uta is incomplete.)
records.en_auxiliary: (The current Uta is incomplete.)
records.en: (The current Uta-san is incomplete.)

records.jp: （フラグメント再接続はできず、<CR>途中でココロトープから追い出された）
records.en_original: (We were chased out of her Heartscape before she could connect with her Fragment...)
records.en_auxiliary: (We were chased out of her Heartscape before she could connect with her Fragment...)
records.en: (We were chased out of her Heartscape before she could connect with her Fragment...)

records.jp: （だから、昔の自分に戻ることもできず、<CR>今の自分を確立することもできてない……）
records.en_original: (So, she can't return to how she was, but she can't establish a new self, either...)
records.en_auxiliary: (So, she can't return to how she was, but she can't establish a new self, either...)
records.en: (So, she can't return to how she was, but she can't establish a new self, either...)

records.jp: いずれもう一度、<CR>あそこには行かないといけないと思うけど……
records.en_original: No matter what we decide to do, we'll probably need to go back there eventually...
records.en_auxiliary: No matter what we decide to do, we'll probably need to go back there eventually...
records.en: No matter what we decide to do, we'll probably need to go back there eventually...

records.jp: はい。今は、やめておいた方がいいと思います……
records.en_original: I know. But I think it's better we forget about it for now.
records.en_auxiliary: I know. But I think it's better we forget about it for now.
records.en: I know. But I think it's better we forget about it for now.

records.jp: どうなってるか分からないしね
records.en_original: We definitely want to take our time.
records.en_auxiliary: We definitely want to take our time.
records.en: We definitely want to take our time.

records.jp: いた
records.en_original: There you are.
records.en_auxiliary: There you are.
records.en: There you are.

records.jp: きらら、ユズさん。どうしたの？
records.en_original: Kirara, Yuzu. What's up?
records.en_auxiliary: Kirara, Yuzu. What's up?
records.en: Kirara, Yuzu-san. What's up?

records.jp: 気になることがある。ちょっと確認したい
records.en_original: We were curious about something. Do you mind?
records.en_auxiliary: We were curious about something. Do you mind?
records.en: We were curious about something. Do you mind?

records.jp: 途中で脱出せざるを得なかったとはいえ、<CR>何も分からなかったというわけじゃない
records.en_original: You said that you had to leave immediately, but you knew something, didn't you?
records.en_auxiliary: You said that you had to leave immediately, but you knew something, didn't you?
records.en: You said that you had to leave immediately, but you knew something, didn't you?

records.jp: そうでしょう、愛央？
records.en_original: Well, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: Well, Ao?
records.en: Well, Ao?

records.jp: あ、うん
records.en_original: Ah... Yeah.
records.en_auxiliary: Ah... Yeah.
records.en: Ah... Yeah.

records.jp: 私は痛みが欲しいの！<CR>人のいない世界なんて意味がないじゃない！
records.en_original: What I want is pain! What's the point of a world without people?!
records.en_auxiliary: What I want is pain! What's the point of a world without people?!
records.en: What I want is pain! What's the point of a world without people?!

records.jp: って感じで、記憶の中の詩さんが<CR>よく分からないことを言ってて……
records.en_original: I heard Uta say that in her memories.
records.en_auxiliary: I heard Uta say that in her memories.
records.en: I heard Uta-san say that in her memories.

records.jp: 人のいない世界……。<CR>皆さんの言う、初期化のことでしょうか……？
records.en_original: A world without people... Could that be the result of the world attempting to reset itself?
records.en_auxiliary: A world without people... Could that be the result of the world attempting to reset itself?
records.en: A world without people... Could that be the result of the world attempting to reset itself?

records.jp: そう、その初期化に関して、話したいことがある
records.en_original: Yes, there's something about that I'd like to discuss with you.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes, there's something about that I'd like to discuss with you.
records.en: Yes, there's something about that I'd like to discuss with you.

records.jp: 話したいこと……？
records.en_original: There is?
records.en_auxiliary: There is?
records.en: There is?

records.jp: あの敵がクラックから出てきた時、“声”を聞いた
records.en_original: When that thing emerged from the Crack, I heard a voice.
records.en_auxiliary: When that thing emerged from the Crack, I heard a voice.
records.en: When that thing emerged from the Crack, I heard a voice.

records.jp: こ、声？<CR>きららが聞く声って……
records.en_original: A-a voice? Does that mean...?
records.en_auxiliary: A-a voice? Does that mean...?
records.en: A-a voice? Does that mean...?

records.jp: そう……神の声
records.en_original: Yes. It was the Divine.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes. It was the Divine.
records.en: Yes. It was the Divine.

records.jp: じゃあ、あの外から入ってきたのは、<CR>神様ってこと……！？
records.en_original: Does that mean the thing that came through the Crack was some kind of god?!
records.en_auxiliary: Does that mean the thing that came through the Crack was some kind of god?!
records.en: Does that mean the thing that came through the Crack was some kind of god?!

records.jp: そうかもしれない……。<CR>世界システムが送ってきた存在なのだから
records.en_original: It is a possibility, as it was an entity sent by the World System itself.
records.en_auxiliary: It is a possibility, as it was an entity sent by the World System itself.
records.en: It is a possibility, as it was an entity sent by the World System itself.

records.jp: 壁が割れた瞬間、頭の中に情報が流れ込んできた。<CR>それは、「きららたちを消せ」という命令……
records.en_original: As soon as the Crack appeared I felt information flood into my head, along with the words, "Delete them."
records.en_auxiliary: As soon as the Crack appeared I felt information flood into my head, along with the words, "Delete them."
records.en: The moment the wall broke, information flooded into Kirara's mind. It was an order: 'Erase Kirara and the others...'

records.jp: 消す……？　殺すじゃなくて？
records.en_original: Deleted? Not killed?
records.en_auxiliary: Deleted? Not killed?
records.en: Deleted? Not killed?

records.jp: 神に、「殺す」なんて人間的な考えはない。<CR>世界にバグが生じたからまとめて消す、それだけ
records.en_original: The gods don't think like us humans do. There's nothing to "kill." We're little more than bugs in their system.
records.en_auxiliary: The gods don't think like us humans do. There's nothing to "kill." We're little more than bugs in their system.
records.en: The gods don't think like us humans do. There's nothing to "kill." We're little more than bugs in their system.

records.jp: 初期化というのは単なる比喩じゃない。<CR>「kill」ではなく「delete」……
records.en_original: "Resetting" isn't just a metaphor. When they talk about deleting us, it is exactly what it sounds like.
records.en_auxiliary: "Resetting" isn't just a metaphor. When they talk about deleting us, it is exactly what it sounds like.
records.en: "Resetting" isn't just a metaphor. When they talk about deleting us, it is exactly what it sounds like.

records.jp: その目的を遂行するため、<CR>世界システムから送り込まれた消滅機構<CR>
records.en_original: To accomplish this, the World System sent an anti-virus to delete us.
records.en_auxiliary: To accomplish this, the World System sent an anti-virus to delete us.
records.en: To accomplish this, the World System sent an anti-virus to delete us.

records.jp: それこそが、あの敵の正体だ
records.en_original: That is the enemy we are dealing with.
records.en_auxiliary: That is the enemy we are dealing with.
records.en: That is the enemy we are dealing with.

records.jp: 正真正銘、世界をまっさらな状態に<CR>還そうとしている、ということですか……？
records.en_original: So they wish to return the world to a blank slate...?
records.en_auxiliary: So they wish to return the world to a blank slate...?
records.en: So they wish to return the world to a blank slate...?

records.jp: なんで、そんなこと……
records.en_original: Why would it do something so horrible...?
records.en_auxiliary: Why would it do something so horrible...?
records.en: Why would it do something so horrible...?

records.jp: 世界システムの考えることなんて分からない。<CR>そもそも、神に考えなんてものがあるのかも疑問だ
records.en_original: It’s impossible for us to try and understand its motivations. How do we understand god?
records.en_auxiliary: It’s impossible for us to try and understand its motivations. How do we understand god?
records.en: It’s impossible for us to try and understand its motivations. How do we understand god?

records.jp: 神はただ、仕組みに従って動いているだけ。<CR>世界システムとは、そういうものだ
records.en_original: The World System simply follows its "programming", as it were. That's it.
records.en_auxiliary: The World System simply follows its "programming", as it were. That's it.
records.en: The World System simply follows its "programming", as it were. That's it.

records.jp: ……分かっているのは、<CR>灰がその初期化現象の表れだってこと
records.en_original: ...What we know for sure, is that the Ash is a part of this reset.
records.en_auxiliary: ...What we know for sure, is that the Ash is a part of this reset.
records.en: ...What we know for sure, is that the Ash is a part of this reset.

records.jp: 私たちはその初期化現象から逃れたってこと
records.en_original: And that we are bugs that slipped through the cracks.
records.en_auxiliary: And that we are bugs that slipped through the cracks.
records.en: And that we are bugs that slipped through the cracks.

records.jp: 残った私たちも逃さず“消す”ため、<CR>消滅機構が追ってきているということ
records.en_original: Which is why the System is attempting to enter the Oasis in order to delete us.
records.en_auxiliary: Which is why the System is attempting to enter the Oasis in order to delete us.
records.en: Which is why the System is attempting to enter the Oasis in order to delete us.

records.jp: そして……それでも私たちは、<CR>システムにされるがまま生きていくしかないということ
records.en_original: And despite all that, our only choice is to follow the whims of the System.
records.en_auxiliary: And despite all that, our only choice is to follow the whims of the System.
records.en: And despite all that, our only choice is to follow the whims of the System.

records.jp: くっそー、横暴だ横暴！
records.en_original: This sucks! This is tyranny!
records.en_auxiliary: This sucks! This is tyranny!
records.en: This sucks! This is tyranny!

records.jp: なんとかして、世界の理に抗う必要があるんですね……
records.en_original: Then we must find some kind of way to overthrow the very System itself...
records.en_auxiliary: Then we must find some kind of way to overthrow the very System itself...
records.en: Then we must find some kind of way to overthrow the very System itself...

records.jp: ……少し考えさせて。<CR>ちょっと、相談してみる
records.en_original: I need some time to think about all this. I'll ask around.
records.en_auxiliary: I need some time to think about all this. I'll ask around.
records.en: I need some time to think about all this. I'll ask around.

records.jp: （今まで、何か引っかかったこととかあったっけ……）
records.en_original: (Has there been anything unusual up until now...?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Has there been anything unusual up until now...?)
records.en: (Has there been anything unusual up until now...?)

records.jp: うーーーーん……
records.en_original: Hmmmmm...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmmmmm...
records.en: Hmmmmm...
